name: Grawa-Wasserfall
kurzbeschreibung: The Grawa Waterfall in the Stubai Valley is the Eastern Alps' widest cascade at 85 m, dropping 180 m with an alpine health lounger observatory.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The monumental Grawa Waterfall in the Stubai Valley tumbles near the cul-de-sac of the valley beneath the Stubai Glacier within the municipality of Neustift. Boasting a cascade width reaching 85 metres, it ranks as the widest waterfall across the entire Eastern Alps. Fed by glacial meltwaters pouring from the Sulzenau glacier, the Sulzaubach torrent plunges over an immense 180-metre granitic gneiss cliff into the valley floor. It forms the centrepiece of the famed 'WildeWasserWeg' hiking experience. The intense impact atomizes crystal meltwater into therapeutic micro-aerosols. Clinical research demonstrates that inhaling this aquatic mist reduces airway inflammation and eases respiratory ailments. Right at the water's impact zone, the barrier-free 'Grawa Observatory' belvedere invites visitors to relax on curved timber loungers. Just across the brook, the heritage-listed, 400-year-old Grawa Alm tavern serves genuine Tyrolean fare.

Route & Anforderungen

Departing from the Grawa Alm car park, an effortless barrier-free gravel walkway leads in roughly 15 minutes straight to the waterfall basin and observatory platform (approx. one kilometre, minimal elevation gain). For energetic hillwalkers, the cataract marks the starting threshold of Stage Two of the WildeWasserWeg: a skillfully engineered mountain trail climbs across rock ledges and belvederes up to the Sulzenaufall and Sulzenauhütte hut at 2,191 metres (approx. 2 to 2.5 hours, 650 metres ascent). Standard sneakers suffice for the valley walk; sturdy lug-soled boots are needed for ascending the canyon. The valley approach is stroller-friendly.

Besuch & Anreise

Access is along the B183 Stubaital federal highway from Schönberg through Neustift toward the Stubai Glacier, with paid parking at Grawa Alm. Rail passengers arrive at Innsbruck Central Station and board regular VVT Stubaital coach route 590 directly to the 'Neustift i. St. Grawa Alm' stop.

Tipps

Recline on the wooden wellness loungers at the Grawa Observatory for 20 minutes to breathe the revitalizing negative ions and ionized mist. Afterwards, unwind in the timber-paneled parlour of the Grawa Alm with authentic Kaiserschmarrn.
preis: Walking trails and Grawa Observatory freely accessible; parking bays at Grawa Alm apply fees
oeffnungszeiten: Accessible year-round; prime visitation season runs May through October
saison: Ganzjährig zugänglich (Sommersaison Mai bis Oktober ideal)
